name: Rudra Sharma
intro: I build backends that hold under load.
The unglamorous work that keeps products running.
summary: Backend engineer with around a year of software development experience across two internships, building Java/Spring Boot and Node.js microservices. Hands-on with event-driven systems (Kafka, BullMQ), multi-tenant SaaS, Redis caching, Keycloak/JWT auth, and AWS.

about.lead: I work on the half of the product nobody sees — the services, the queues, the caches.
about.detail: Most of what I build sits behind an API — Spring Boot and Node.js services that pass messages through Kafka and BullMQ instead of blocking a request. I've shipped a multi-tenant SaaS ERP for 45 tenants, an ingestion pipeline that chews through 10M+ listings in under 15 seconds, and auth layers nobody has had to think about since. I care about the parts that only show up under load.
